Dear [Mr Innes](/person/744)
If you look at the notice at p. 499 of the May no and 599 of the June you will see the fees as to questions fully explained. In fact I do not know what more there is to say about them.[^1]
[Bishop Jenner](/person/758) has carefully looked over the [Prayer book Lessons](/book/202) and returned them to me and I am going over them with his criticisms. Half is quite ready if you want it for the printers.
I should much prefer having a sum at once- say[£50 for the first thousand](/topic/160), and then a royalty on what afterwards sold
In the last number of the [Packet](/periodical/52) ‘Early Recollections’ are by
[Mrs Brougham](/person/207)
Castlehaven Rectory,
Castle Townsend
Co Cork
I think you have the others

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
The One Grief is by
[Miss E Bussell](/person/232)
St James’ Parsonage
Dingwall


[^1]: These were fees for participating in the preparation for the English Literature part of the Cambridge Local Examination.
